text:
Served items: 6 sushi rolls (salmon/avocado/tempura-type fillings), about 40 g rice each, roughly 50-60 kcal per piece, so 6 pieces come to about 330 kcal. Cabbage slaw with a light dressing is about 80 kcal. Fruit salad (strawberry, apple, mango) is about 80 kcal. Latte, about 8 oz with milk, is about 100 kcal. Soy sauce is about 10 kcal. Total served is about 600 kcal.

Left over: the fruit looks nearly uneaten, about 70 kcal. The slaw has a little left, about 10 kcal. The latte is finished, with a little residue. The soy sauce cups are nearly full, since the plate shows some used sauce. The sushi is all eaten. Total left over is about 85 kcal.

Eaten: about 515 kcal.

Macros eaten: sushi (330 kcal) has about 12 g protein, 55 g carbs and 7 g fat. Slaw (70 kcal) has about 1 g protein, 8 g carbs and 4 g fat. The latte (100 kcal) has about 6 g protein, 9 g carbs and 4 g fat. Sauce and other items add about 1 g protein and 2 g carbs. Totals are about 20 g protein, 74 g carbs and 15 g fat.
